opening.argument: The video shows a Yamaha RayZR 125 scooter on a showroom platform, describes its 125cc fuel-injected engine, and gives an ex-showroom price in West Bengal. The speaker invites viewers to visit the showrooms for suggestions and recommends buying the scooter. Those are ordinary features of vehicle promotion, not requests for investments, credentials, or unusual payments. Claims of increased power and mileage are product-performance claims; the video does not establish the comparison or testing behind them. That limitation matters, but an unsupported performance comparison alone does not establish deception.
